persistent.description: If true, store journal files persistently on disk (in /var/log/journal). If false, store in RAM only (/run/log/journal), losing logs on reboot.

data_directory.description: Absolute path to store persistent journal files. Leave empty to auto-select (/var/log/journal if Storage=persistent, /run/log/journal otherwise).

system_max_use.description: Maximum disk space allowed for journal files. Supports units: K, M, G, T, P (or percentages like 10% of the filesystem).

system_max_free_space.description: Maximum free space to leave on the filesystem before removing old journal files.

system_max_file_size.description: Maximum size of a single journal file before rotation.

system_keep_free.description: Minimum free space to keep on the filesystem (prevents journal from consuming all free space).

max_file_lifetime.description: Maximum time to retain journal entries (e.g. 30d, 1year, 2weeks).

volatile_max_file_lifetime.description: Maximum retention time for volatile (RAM) journal files.

compress.description: Whether to compress journal files using a configurable algorithm.

compress_threshold.description: Journal entries newer than this are not compressed. Set to '0' to disable time-based threshold.

rate_limit_interval.description: Time window for rate limiting journal writes (e.g. 30s, 2min).

rate_limit_burst.description: Maximum number of log messages allowed within the interval before throttling.

timestamp.description: Timestamp format for journal entries: 'monotonic', 'boot', 'realtime', or 'hires'.

forward_to_syslog.description: If true, forward entries to the system syslog daemon (e.g., rsyslog).

syslog_socket.description: Path to the Unix socket used to forward to syslog. Set to empty string to disable.

forward_to_kmsg.description: If true, write entries to the kernel log buffer (dmesg).

forward_to_console.description: If true, send entries to the system console (visible on serial/tty).

console_level.description: Minimum log level (debug, info, notice, warning, err, crit, alert, emerg) for console output.

max_lines.description: Maximum number of journal lines shown per file during interactive display.

show_catalog.description: If true, show human-friendly descriptions (from message catalogs) when viewing logs.

header.description: If true, read kernel messages and include them in journal (equivalent to ReadKMsg).

extra_fields.description: List of static key-value fields to append to all journal entries (e.g., for environment tagging). Each item is a field object.

name.description: Field name (must start with uppercase letter and contain only uppercase letters, digits, and underscore).

namespace.description: Namespace name for journal isolation (e.g., for containers). Leave blank to disable.

exclude_units.description: List of systemd unit names whose logs should be excluded from journald capture.
